+def test_extract_internal_symlinks_from_built_collection(collection_input, tmp_path):
+    input_dir, output_dir = collection_input
+    os.makedirs(os.path.join(input_dir, 'playbooks', 'roles'))
+    os.makedirs(os.path.join(input_dir, 'roles', 'linked'))
+    os.symlink(os.path.join(input_dir, 'roles', 'linked'),
+               os.path.join(input_dir, 'playbooks', 'roles', 'linked'))
+    os.symlink(os.path.join(input_dir, 'README.md'),
+               os.path.join(input_dir, 'docs', 'README.md'))
+
+    collection.build_collection(input_dir, output_dir, False)
+    artifact = os.path.join(output_dir, 'ansible_namespace-collection-0.1.0.tar.gz')
+    dest = to_bytes(str(tmp_path / 'installed'))
+    os.makedirs(dest)
+    with tarfile.open(artifact) as archive:
+        collection._extract_tar_dir(archive, 'playbooks/roles/linked', dest)
+        collection._extract_tar_file(archive, 'docs/README.md', dest, to_bytes(str(tmp_path)))
+
+    assert os.path.islink(os.path.join(dest, b'playbooks/roles/linked'))
